exposure: Increased number of previous cesarean deliveries
cohort: 256 first-trimester pregnant women with a history of uterine scarring, randomly selected from an antenatal outpatient clinic.
finding: 3D ultrasound combined with Doppler imaging demonstrated substantial agreement across trimesters for identifying features suggestive of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS), and advanced maternal age, high parity, and multiple previous cesarean deliveries were identified as key maternal risk factors.
gest_age: First trimester at enrollment; observations followed up to 28 weeks of gestation.
